description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions supporting pairing alert UI and logic for a macOS application, including managing alert presentation, user responses, and pairing request handling.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that can become key or main window, used as a host window for pairing alerts.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: Holds current state regarding active alert, request ID, and alert host window, used to manage alert lifecycle within the application.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active NSAlert, dismissing its sheet if applicable.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures a host window exists for presenting alerts, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures an NSAlert with style, buttons, and optional destructive action based on macOS version.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Presents an alert as a sheet centered over its host window.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Asynchronous task to handle pairing push notifications, including refresh and subscription consumption.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a background task to continuously listen for pairing push notifications.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert with specified message and informative text.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert for a specific request, manages active alert state.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears current alert and request ID, hides alert window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, cancels background tasks, and cleans up alert state.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Executes an async action to approve a pairing request, logs the outcome.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Executes an async action to reject a pairing request, logs the outcome.
